response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE rental_duration >= 5 GROUP BY rating), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS value FROM per_rating) SELECT p.rating, p.avg_rate_per_day, p.film_count, p.avg_rate_per_day / b.value AS relative_to_benchmark FROM per_rating AS p CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE b.value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.rating
